bandReport.notes: 25 questions, Q96-Q120 contiguous, none missing or duplicated. PAPER ENDS AT Q120: p19 is the last rendered page (printed page 39), Q120's option block closes in the right column well above the footer, and the remainder of the page is blank. There is NO trailing blank or rough-work page in the render (p00-p19 all carry questions). CONTRARY TO THE BRIEFING: this booklet does NOT print '[ P.T.O.' in its footers at all — p16/p17/p18/p19 footers carry only 'JNUP-B-GKL' and the page number, so the absence of P.T.O. on the last page is not distinguishing here; the blank lower half of p19 and the contiguous run to 120 are the evidence. Printed page numbers advance by 2 per rendered page (p16=33, p17=35, p18=37, p19=39), i.e. one PNG per printed odd page; question numbering is nevertheless contiguous across the boundaries, so nothing is lost between renders. Band edges: Q96 on p16 is complete and starts a fresh question (Q95 and earlier belong to B3); Q120 on p19 is complete. Nothing on my pages belongs to a neighbouring band. Every question on these four pages carries exactly 4 options labelled (a)-(d). NON-ASCENDING code options confirmed by 7x crop in Q111 ((b) 3 1 4 2 before (c) 3 4 1 2 and (d) 2 1 4 3 last) and Q102 ((c) 3 1 4 2 before (d) 3 4 1 2); Q98's order options are also non-ascending. No 'How many of the above statements' counting item on these pages, and no self-referential option such as 'Both (b) and (c)'. Q120's options are printed as a TWO-COLUMN table under the italic headers 'Lok Sabha' and 'Rajya Sabha'; the headers are carried in the stem and each option transcribed as the comma-joined pair in that column order.
